title: Title & Registration Services Late-Penalty Reimbursement: Vehicle Program Addition
content:
On a Title & Registration Services late-penalty reimbursement, the reimbursed share is raised for the vehicle program on the purchase order under Vehicle Purchase Agreements: by one tenth (0.10) for a Kestrel Premium Certified or Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle, by one twentieth (0.05) for a Kestrel Certified or Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle, and by nothing for other programs. The share as raised never exceeds one; the reimbursement is the reimbursable penalty multiplied by it and rounded half up to the cent only at the end.

| Vehicle program on the purchase order | Addition to the reimbursed share |
|---|---|
| Kestrel Premium Certified, Kestrel Factory Certified | 0.10 |
| Kestrel Certified, Kestrel Certified Plus | 0.05 |
| Kestrel Value Line, Kestrel Inspected | nothing |

## Hypothetical illustrations

- A Kestrel Certified Plus vehicle with a share of 0.70: the share becomes 0.75.
- A Kestrel Factory Certified vehicle with a share of 0.96: 1.06 is held at one.
